findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "reminder_manage" is 766 chars, far longer than this server's median (149). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Create, list, update, complete, snooze, delete, or restore reminders. • action="create": Create a reminder for a contact. Requires contact_id, title, and remind…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "prime" stacks urgency/override words (important, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: notification_list, notification_read, prime, manage_push_notifications · Private data: contact_create, contact_get, contact_update, contact_delete, contact_restore, contact_list, contact_merge, contact_find_duplicates, contact_method_manage, address_manage, food_preferences_get, food_preferences_upsert, custom_field_manage, relationship_manage, note_manage, note_list, tag_manage, activity_manage, activity_list, life_event_manage, contact_timeline, reminder_manage, gift_manage, gift_list, debt_manage, data_export, data_statistics, prime, upcoming_birthdays, global_search, contacts_needing_attention, upcoming_reminders, batch_create_contacts, batch_tag_contacts · Public sink: contact_find_duplicates, contact_method_manage, prime, manage_settings · Destructive: contact_delete, contact_method_manage, address_manage, custom_field_manage, relationship_manage, note_manage, tag_manage, activity_manage, activity_type_manage, life_event_manage, reminder_manage, gift_manage, debt_manage, task_manage, manage_settings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: notification_list, notification_read, prime, manage_push_notifications · Private data: contact_create, contact_get, contact_update, contact_delete, contact_restore, contact_list, contact_merge, contact_find_duplicates, contact_method_manage, address_manage, food_preferences_get, food_preferences_upsert, custom_field_manage, relationship_manage, note_manage, note_list, tag_manage, activity_manage, activity_list, life_event_manage, contact_timeline, reminder_manage, gift_manage, gift_list, debt_manage, data_export, data_statistics, prime, upcoming_birthdays, global_search, contacts_needing_attention, upcoming_reminders, batch_create_contacts, batch_tag_contacts · Public sink: contact_find_duplicates, contact_method_manage, prime, manage_settings · Destructive: contact_delete, contact_method_manage, address_manage, custom_field_manage, relationship_manage, note_manage, tag_manage, activity_manage, activity_type_manage, life_event_manage, reminder_manage, gift_manage, debt_manage, task_manage, manage_settings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
